name: codebrain-lge
description: Local semantic code intelligence for VS Code: native-accelerated runtime, MCP, impact analysis, affected tests, workflow graphs, and read-only AI review.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeBrain installs the CodeGraph runtime from npm, runs it locally, and reads workspace source files.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The local CodeBrain runtime requires a filesystem-backed workspace.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open a folder or workspace, and CodeBrain will list every project in it that has an index.

No CodeBrain index was found in this workspace.
[Index this workspace](command:codebrain.initializeWorkspace)
You can also right-click any folder in the Explorer and choose “CodeBrain: Index This Folder”, or index a repository's submodules in one step.
[Index submodules](command:codebrain.initializeSubmodules)

chatParticipants.name: codebrain
chatParticipants.description: Explain, implement, fix, and review code with your code graph and Jira/Confluence context.
chatParticipants.sampleRequest: How does a login request reach the database?

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain how a workflow works — business steps, code flow with file:line, diagrams. Ask for a "user guide" to get a step-by-step guide instead.
commands.sampleRequest: How does a login request reach the database?

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Plan a feature or Jira ticket: acceptance criteria, where the change plugs in, file-by-file steps, tests, and risks — then hand it to the CodeBrain Dev agent to edit and verify.
commands.sampleRequest: Implement ABC-123: allow users to reset their password by email.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review your changes: risk verdict, findings with file:line, blast radius, affected tests, and acceptance-criteria coverage when a ticket is involved.
commands.sampleRequest: Review my current changes for regression risk and missing tests.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Analyze a bug, trace its root cause through the code graph, and propose a concrete solution and validation plan.
commands.sampleRequest: Checkout throws a null reference on an empty cart — find the root cause.

disambiguation.description: Explains what code does, why it exists, and how control or data flows through functions.
examples: What is this function used for?
How does this request workflow work?
Explain the purpose of the selected code.
Write a user guide for the export feature.
Viết tài liệu hướng dẫn cho chức năng này.

disambiguation.description: Reviews architecture and changed workflows together with code correctness, boundary safety, affected methods, regressions, test gaps, and release risk.
examples: What can break if I change this?
Assess the release risk and missing tests for this diff.
Which tests are affected by my changes?
Phân tích ảnh hưởng của thay đổi này.

disambiguation.description: Plans a feature or Jira ticket against the code graph — acceptance criteria, where the change plugs in, file-by-file steps, tests, and risks — and hands it to an editing agent.
examples: Add rate limiting to the login endpoint.
Triển khai chức năng xuất báo cáo PDF.

codebrain.runtime.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: Install new releases of the CodeGraph runtime (`@xuansang2770/codegraph` on npm) in the background. Agents you registered with **CodeBrain: Install MCP + Skill for Agents** are repointed at the new version automatically. Run **CodeBrain: Update CodeGraph Runtime** to check now.

codebrain.runtime.version.markdownDescription: Which `@xuansang2770/codegraph` release to run: `latest`, another npm dist-tag, or an exact version such as `1.6.1` to pin it. A pinned version is installed even when auto-update is off.

codebrain.runtime.registry.markdownDescription: npm registry to install the runtime from, for example an internal mirror. Leave empty to use your npm configuration (`.npmrc`), or `https://registry.npmjs.org/` when npm is not installed.

codebrain.runtime.path.markdownDescription: Use a CodeGraph runtime directory you manage yourself (one holding `node`, `lib/` and `bin/`, such as an unpacked `@xuansang2770/codegraph-<platform>` package or a local build). Disables the npm install and auto-update.

codebrain.mcp.reviewTool.markdownDescription: Expose CodeGraph's `codegraph_review` tool alongside `codegraph_explore` on the CodeBrain MCP server — in VS Code and in every agent registered with **CodeBrain: Install MCP + Skill for Agents**. It reports changed signatures and removed exports whose callers outside the diff still use them, the blast radius, and untested changed code. Turn off to offer `codegraph_explore` only.

codebrain.autoRefresh.enabled.description: Keep the index fresh with CodeBrain's native watcher while the CodeGraph MCP runtime is active.

codebrain.autoRefresh.debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a burst of file changes is incrementally synced.

codebrain.chat.maxContextFiles.description: Maximum number of source files returned by CodeBrain for a chat report. Leave unset to scale the budget to the size of the indexed project.

codebrain.chat.maxFollowUpLookups.description: How many extra CodeBrain lookups the model may request while writing a report when the first one left a gap. Set to 0 to answer from a single lookup.

codebrain.chat.maxDiffCharacters.description: Maximum Git diff size supplied to code review commands. Larger diffs are truncated with an explicit warning.

codebrain.chat.showTokenUsage.description: Show model-specific estimated token counts and latency for each CodeBrain chat request.

codebrain.impact.maxDepth.description: Maximum dependency depth for affected-test detection.

codebrain.metrics.enabled.description: Store workspace-local estimates of context tokens and file reads saved by impact analysis.

codebrain.ai.model.description: Language model id for CodeBrain-owned AI commands such as Review Changes. Leave empty to use the first available model. This does not override the model selected for CodeBrain ChatParticipant requests.

codebrain.review.instructionFile.description: Workspace-relative Markdown file with additional CodeBrain review priorities. Core review safety rules cannot be overridden.

enumDescriptions: feat(auth): add refresh tokens — Conventional Commits.
TPLD-958: Fix Chart lag issue — issue key from the branch name, a blank line, then a nested detail list.
Fix chart lag when the window is resized — one imperative sentence, body only when it earns one.
codebrain.commit.format.description: Commit message format CodeBrain writes. A custom template file, when the repository has one, overrides this.

codebrain.commit.language.description: Language for generated commit messages, for example "Vietnamese". Leave empty to let the model follow the repository's existing history.

codebrain.commit.templateFile.description: Workspace-relative Markdown file holding the commit message instructions CodeBrain sends to the model. Commit it to share one convention with your team. Falls back to the built-in Conventional Commits template when the file is missing.

codebrain.commit.maxDiffCharacters.description: Maximum diff size sent when generating a commit message. A truncated diff is reported to the model so it does not describe changes it cannot see.

enumDescriptions: UI behavior, state, accessibility, browser security, and frontend performance.
API contracts, security, persistence, reliability, and operations.
End-to-end UI, API, persistence, and contract consistency.
Memory safety, concurrency, real-time behavior, and embedded recovery.
Threat boundaries, authorization, data exposure, and abuse cases.
Latency, throughput, resource usage, and failure recovery.
Regression matrix, migration safety, and release readiness.
codebrain.review.profile.description: Built-in review priorities for this workspace. Extend them with codebrain.review.instructionFile when needed.

codebrain.review.refreshIndexBeforeRun.description: Refresh the CodeBrain index before impact analysis and review when the workspace has changed since the last refresh. Analyses stop if a needed refresh fails instead of using stale graph data.

codebrain.chat.openReportPreview.description: Also open each @codebrain chat answer in VS Code's Markdown preview. Off by default: the answer is already in the chat, and the Open report preview button opens it on demand.

codebrain.reports.openPreview.description: Automatically open generated Markdown reports in VS Code's preview.

codebrain.releaseNotes.showOnUpdate.markdownDescription: Open a "What's new" page the first time CodeBrain starts after an update, listing everything released since the version you were on. Never shown on a fresh install, and never twice for the same version. Run **CodeBrain: What's New** to open it on demand.

codebrain.codeLens.enabled.description: Show each file's blast radius (dependents and affected tests) as a CodeLens above line 1.

codebrain.impact.detectDepthTruncation.description: Probe one level past codebrain.impact.maxDepth to detect whether the dependency traversal was cut short. When it was, CodeBrain reports the dependent counts as a lower bound instead of presenting them as complete.

codebrain.atlassian.jiraUrl.markdownDescription: Jira base URL for the bundled Atlassian MCP server, for example `https://jira.example.com` (Cloud: `https://your-site.atlassian.net`). Set the token with "CodeBrain: Configure Atlassian (Collab + Jira)" — tokens are stored in the OS keychain, never in settings.

codebrain.atlassian.confluenceUrl.markdownDescription: Confluence (Collab) base URL **including its context path**, for example `https://collab.example.com` (Cloud: `https://your-site.atlassian.net/wiki`).

codebrain.atlassian.username.markdownDescription: Atlassian account email. Required only for Cloud, where an API token authenticates as `email:token`. Leave empty for Server/Data Center personal access tokens, which authenticate as a bearer token.

codebrain.atlassian.maxResults.description: Default number of Jira issues, Confluence pages, or comments returned per search.

codebrain.atlassian.maxBodyCharacters.description: Maximum characters of a Confluence page body or Jira description returned in one tool call. Longer content is truncated with an explicit note so the agent knows the text was cut.

codebrain.atlassian.allowWrite.markdownDescription: Let agents **change** Jira and Confluence: comment on and transition issues, assign them, and create, update or comment on pages. Off by default — while it is off those tools are not offered to any agent at all, so the server can only read. Turning it on affects every agent sharing these credentials (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity).

codebrain.atlassian.maxImageBytes.description: Largest single attached image returned inline by the image tools. Bigger images are listed by name and skipped instead of being sent.

codebrain.atlassian.sslVerify.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the Jira and Confluence hosts. Turn this off only for an internal deployment behind a private certificate authority.

codebrain.jira.defaultProject.markdownDescription: Jira project keys the board starts filtered to, for example `TPLD` or `TPLD, WEB`. Leave empty for every project your query matches. Change it per session with **Select projects…** in the board's filter bar, which lists the projects your account can browse.

codebrain.jira.maxIssues.description: How many issues one board load fetches. The board says so when Jira had more, because a filter can only narrow what was already loaded.

codebrain.jira.autoRefreshMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic board reloads. Reloads happen only while the window has focus. Set to 0 to refresh only when you ask.

codebrain.jira.dueSoonDays.description: An open issue due this many days from now, or sooner, is flagged as due soon.

codebrain.jira.staleDays.description: An in-progress issue with no update for this many days is flagged as stale.

codebrain.jira.branchTemplate.markdownDescription: Branch name suggested when you start work on an issue. Placeholders: `{key}` (TPLD-958), `{summary}` (slug of the summary), `{prefix}` (`feature`, `bugfix`, `hotfix`, `chore` or `spike`, from the issue type), `{type}`. The suggestion is always editable before the branch is created.

codebrain.jira.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Branch a new issue branch is created from, for example `develop`. Leave empty to branch off whatever is checked out.

codebrain.jira.jql.markdownDescription: Advanced: JQL that replaces every condition the board would generate — the who/project/progress filters stop applying to the query (they still narrow what is already loaded). Ordering is appended unless your JQL brings its own `ORDER BY`.

codebrain.jira.statusBar.description: Show the issue key from the current branch in the status bar, with its status, and turn it amber when that issue is overdue.

codebrain.tests.command.description: Command used by "CodeBrain: Run Affected Tests". Use ${files} where the affected test paths should go (for example: npx vitest run ${files}). Leave empty to detect the project's test runner and confirm before running.
